text.body: śrīḥ śarīravādaḥ śrīkāntakāntapadapaṅkajasaurabhaśrīpārīṇacittanibhaṣaṭcaraṇaḥ pravīṇaḥ| śrīlakṣmaṇāryamabhivandya śarīravādaṃ sārārthasaṅgatamanantasudhīrvidhatte|| "iha tāvaccharīraśabdapravṛttinimittaṃ vicāryate||" śarīrapadapravṛttinimittabhūtaṃ śarīratvaṃ hi na tāvajjātiḥ,tatsādhakapramāṇābhāvāt|| na ca - idaṃ śarīramidaṃ śarīramityanugatapratītireva tatsādhikā,anugatapratīterbādhakavirahe jātisādhakatvāt - iti vācyam| siddhānte anugatapratīteḥ saṃsthānaviṣayakatvena tadatiriktajātisādhakatvāsambhavāt|| na ca - saṃsthānasyāvayavasaṃyogādirūpatvena prativyaktibhinnatvātkathamanugatapratītiviṣayatvamiti - vācyam| naiyāyikādimate suvarṇarajatatāmramṛdghaṭādibhedena bhinnasya ghaṭatvasya ghaṭo'yaṃ ghaṭo'yamityādyanugatapratītiviṣayatvavatsaṃsthānasyāpi tadupapatteḥ,suvarṇarajatādighaṭeṣu ghaṭatvasyaikye sāṅkaryāpatteḥ|| kiṃ ca - gotvādijātirūpatvenābhimataṃ saṃsthānaṃ hi nāvayavasaṃyogasvarūpaṃ, rūparasādiṣu guṇeṣvātmādidravyeṣu coktasaṃsthānābhāvena tatrātiriktajātikalpanāpatteḥ ; kiṃ tu viṣayatāsambandhena yāvadgovyaktiṣu sambaddhaṃ tāvadviṣayakajñānameva| tadeva ca iyaṃ gaurityādipratītau svarūpataḥ prakāratayā bhāsata iti na vyaktibhedena saṃsthānasya bhedo'pi, yāvadghaṭādiviṣayakajñānameva yāvadghaṭavyaktiṣvanugatamanatiprasaktaṃ ghaṭatvādinātiriti tadeva daṇḍādijanyatāvacchedakaṃ ghaṭapadaśakyatāvacchedakaṃ ceti - vādāntare spaṣṭam|| tadidamabhipretyoktaṃ "jijñāsādhikaraṇabhāṣye" "saṃsthānaṃ nāma svāsādhāraṇarūpamiti yathāvastusaṃsthānamanusandheyam" iti|| "uktaṃ ca nyāyasiddhāñjane" "ekajātīyamitivyavahārasya tattadupādhiviśeṣeṇopapatteḥ, rāśisainyapariṣadādiṣvaikyavyavahāravat| upādhiścāyamanekeṣāmekasmṛtisamārohaḥ" iti|| tathā ca - tāvadviṣayakajñānameva siddhānte jātiḥ, tasya svarūpato bhānaṃ ceṣṭamiti prakṛte'pi idaṃ śarīramidaṃ śarīramityādipratīteḥ tāvadviṣayakajñānarūpajātiviṣayakatvāṅgīkāreṇa tasyaiva śarīrapadapravṛttinimittatvasvīkāre śarīraśabdasya ghaṭādiśabdavatsasambandhikatvānupapattiḥ| sasambandhikatvaṃ hi sambandhiviṣayakākāṅakṣotthāpakatvaṃ| tañca jātipravṛttinimittakatve na ghaṭate, gavādiśabdavat| atastadatiriktaṃ pravṛttinimittaṃ vācyamityabhipretyoktaṃ "na tu dṛṣṭāntabhāvādityatra śrībhāṣye" "yasya cetanasya yaddravyaṃ sarvātmanā svārthe niyantuṃ dhārayituṃ śakyaṃ,taccheṣataikasvarūpaṃ ca, tattasya śarīramiti śarīralakṣaṇamāstheyam" iti|| "atra śrutaprakāśikānusāriṇaḥ" 'yasya cetanasya yaddravyaṃ sarvātmanā svārthe niyantuṃ śakyaṃ tattasya śarīram' iti "prathamalakṣaṇaṃ"| rājaniyāmyo bhṛtya ityādau rājakṛtiprayukta ceṣṭāśrayatvasya bhṛtyādau bodhātkṛtiprayuktasvīyaceṣṭāsāmānyakatvarūpaniyāmyatvaṃ śarīrapadapravṛttinimittamityarthaḥ| etajjīvasya idaṃ śarīramityādau ṣaṣṭhayartha ādheyatvaṃ| tasya śarīrapadārthaikadeśakṛtāvanvayādetajjīvaniṣṭhakṛtiprayuktasvīyaceṣṭāsāmānyakamidamiti bodhaḥ| uktarītyaiva ca 'yasyātmā śarīraṃ,yasya pṛthivī śarīram' ityādau bodha ūhyaḥ| atra bhṛtyo rājaśarīramiti vyavahāraṇāya sāmānyapadaniveśanaṃ| bhṛtyaniṣṭhaceṣṭāviśeṣasya rājakṛtiprayuktatve'pi tatsāmānyasya tatprayuktatvavirahāt| evaṃ ca parakāyaprāṇendriyādīnāmapi na tajjīvaṃ prati śarīravyavahāraviṣayatvaṃ; parakāyagataceṣṭāsāmānyasya tajjavikṛtiprayutvābhāvāt, prāṇendriyāṇāmetajjīvamokṣānantaramapyā pralayamavasthānena tadīyaceṣṭāsāmānyasya tatkṛtiprayuktatvābhāvāt| dharmabhūtajñānasya jīvakṛtiprayuktaceṣṭāsāmānyakatvāṅgīkāre jñānametasya śarīramiyādivyavahāravāraṇāya jñānāvacchinnānuyogitākasambandhapratiyogitvamapyuktalakṣaṇe praveśyam| jñānapratiyogikasambandhaśva na jñānāvacchinnānuyogitākaḥ|| itthaṃ ca jñānāṃvacchinnānuyogitākasambandhapratiyogitve sati kṛtiprayuktasvīyaceṣṭāsāmānyakatvaṃ śarīrapadapravṛttinimittamiti phalitam|| etajjīvasya idaṃ śarīramityādau ṣaṣṭhayarthādheyatvasya śarīrapadārthaikadeśe anuyogitāyāṃ kṛtau cānvayaṃ svīkṛtya bodha ūhyaḥ|| jīvaśarīre vṛkṣādāvīśvaraśarīre parvatādau ca sūkṣmasya tattatkṛtiprayuktaceṣṭāviśeṣasyāṅgīkārānna śarīravyavahāraviṣayatvānupapattiḥ|| uktaṃ ca "nyāyasiddhāñjane" "sthāvarādāvatisūkṣmasya niyamanaviśeṣasyāsmadādibhirdurgrahatvāt" iti|| "yadi ca" - sthāvarādau parvatādau ca sūkṣmatayā ceṣṭāviśeṣasadbhāvemānābhāvāduktalakṣaṇāvyāptirityucyate,"tadā"etadasvarasenaiva "lakṣaṇāntaramuktaṃ śrībhāṣye" "yasya cetanasya yaddravyaṃ sarvātmanā dhārayituṃ śakyam, tattasya śarīram" iti|| kṛtiprayuktasvapratiyogikapatanapratibandhakasaṃyogasāmānyakatvaṃ śarīrapadapravṛttinimittamityarthaḥ| etajjīvasyedaṃ śarīramityādau ṣaṣṭhayarthādheyatvasya kṛtāvanvayādetajjīvaniṣṭhatiprayuktasvapratiyogikapatanapratibandhakasaṃyogasāmānyakamidamiti bodhaḥ| atra sāmānyapadopādānānnaḥ putraḥ pituśśarīramiti vyavahārāpattiḥ| putrapratiyogikapatanapratibandhakasaṃyogaviśeṣasya pitṛkṛtiprayuktatve'pi tatsāmānyasya tatprayuktatvābhāvāt|| na ca - yādṛśayūkādikaṃ kasya cicchirasyevotpannaṃ tatraiva naṣṭaṃ, tādṛśayūkādau taccharīravyavahārāpattirevamapi durvāreti - vācyam||yūkādiśarīpratīyogikasaṃyogaḥ tadīyajīvānuyogikaḥ, etadīyaśiro'nuyogikaśca| tatraitacchiro'nuyogikayūkādiśarīrādipratiyogikasaṃyogasya etatkṛtiprayuktatve'pi tadīyajīvānuyogikasaṃyogasya etatkṛtiprayuktatvābhāvenoktadoṣavirahāt|| na caivaṃ caitrasyedaṃ śarīramiti vyavahārānupapattiḥ ; etaccharīrapratiyogikātmānuyogikasaṃyogasya caitrakṛtiprayuktatve'pi bhūtalānuyogikasaṃyogasya caitrakṛtiprayuktatvābhāvāditivācyam| bhūtalānuyokasaṃyogasyāpi caitraśarīrakriyājanyatvenaṃ caitrakṛtiprayuktatvānapāyāt| svapratiyogikatvāniveśe caitrasyedaṃ śarīramityādyanupapattiḥ śarīrakriyāṃ vinā'pi jāte śarīrānuyogikapaṭādipratiyogikasaṃyoge caitrakṛtiprayuktatvābhāvāt| atastanniveśaḥ|| "atha" gurutvavatsu dravyeṣu patanasya prasaktatayā tatpratiyogikasaṃyoge patanapratibandhakatvasvīkāre'pi gurutvaśūnyajīvādipratiyogikasaṃyogasya patanapratibandhakatvāsambhavāt "yasyātmā śarīram" ityādiśrautavyavahārānupapattiḥ - "iti cenna||" jagadādhāratvādibodhakaśrutibalādeva jīvādipratiyogikeśvarānuyokasaṃyogasyāpi patanaprativandhakatvābhyupagamāt, ādhāratāyāḥ patanapratibandhakasaṃyogānuyogitvarūpatvāt| patanapratibandhakatvaṃ parityajya kṛtiprayuktasvapratiyogikasaṃyogasāmānyasya śarīrapadapravṛttinimittatvasvīkāre'pi kṣātivirahāñca| saubhariprabhṛtiyogināṃ yānyekadā'nekaśarīrāṇi, yāni ca muktasya "sa ekadhā bhavati, dvidhā bhavati" ityādiśrutisiddhānyanekaśarīrāṇi, tatra sarvaśarīreṣu jīvānuyogapratiyogitvābhāve'pi tādṛśaśarīrapratiyogikasaṃyogasāmānye tattadātmakṛtiprayuktatvānapāyānna doṣaḥ|| atra niruktaśarīralakṣaṇasya kālādivibhudravyeṣvavyāptiḥ| vibhūnāṃ mitho nityasaṃyogasya siddhānte'ṅgīkāreṇa kālādipratiyogikasaṃyogasāmānyasyeśvarakṛtiprayuktatvāsambhavāt| kṛtiprayuktasvapratiyogikajanyasaṃyogasāmānyakatvasya śarīrapadapravṛttinimittatve janyatvasya dhvasaṃpratiyogitbatvaprāgabhāvapratiyogitvatvādirūpavikalpagrāsenaḥ pravṛttinimittabhedāpattyā śarīrapadasya nānārthatvāpattiḥ|| "ato lakṣaṇāntaramuktam" "yasya cetanasya yaddravyaṃ sarvātmanāśeṣataikasvarūpaṃ,tattasya śarīram" iti|| taccheṣatvaṃ hi tanniṣṭhātiśayādhāyakatvaṃ| prakṛte ca tanniṣṭhātiśvāyaḥ kāryatvakāraṇatvānyatararūpaḥ| tadādhāyakatvaṃ ca tadavacchedakatvaṃ| tathā ca - jñānāvacchinnānuyogitākāpṛthaksiddhisambandhāvacchinnakāryatvakāraṇatvānyatarāvacchedakatvaṃ śarīrapadapravṛttinimittamityarthaḥ| sūkṣmacidacidviśiṣṭabrahmaṇaḥ kāraṇatvāt sthūlacidacidviśiṣṭasya ca tasya kāryatvāt brahmaniṣṭhakāryatvakāraṇatvānyatarābacchedakatvasya prapañcasāmānye sattvāt prapañcasya śarīratvopapattiriti "yasyātmā śarīraṃ,yasya pṛthivī śarīraṃ" "jagatsarvaṃ śarīraṃ te" ityādivyavahāropapattiḥ|| tatra ṣaṣṭhayarthādheyatvasya kāryatvakāraṇatvānyatarasminnanvayādbrahmaniṣṭhakāraṇatvakāryatvānyatarāvacchedikā pṛthivītyādirityādibodhaḥ| jīvasyāpi śarīraviśiṣṭasyaiva sukhaduḥkhādikāryakāritvāttaccharīrasya tanniṣṭhakāraṇatvāvacchedakatvāt etajjīvasyedaṃ śarīramityādivyavahāranirvāhaḥ|| "yadyapi" - jīvasya sukhādikāryaṃ prati śarīraviśiṣṭatvena na kāraṇatvaṃ,śarīraviśiṣṭātmatvenātmaviśiṣṭaśarīratvena vā kāraṇatetyatra vinigamanā viraheṇa gurutarakāryakāraṇabhāvadvayāpatteḥ ; kiṃ tu daṇḍacakrādinyāyena śarīrasyātmanaśca pratyekameva kāraṇatādvayamiti "etajjīvasyedaṃ śarīram" ityādikaṃ nopapadyate| "tathā'pi" - uktalakṣaṇe kāraṇatāyāḥ prayojakatāsādhāraṇarūpeṇaiva niveśena śararitmanoḥ pratyekaṃ kāraṇatve'pi ekaviśiṣṭāparatvarūpasāmagrītvena kāryotpattiprayojakatvākṣateḥ jīvaniṣṭhaprayojakatāvacchedakatvamādāyaiva uktavyavahāropapattiḥ| uktāvacchedakatāyāmapṛthaksiddhasambandhāvacchinnatvaniveśāñca bhṛtyaviśiṣṭarājādeḥ kāryakāritve'pi na bhṛtyorājaśarīramiti vyavahārāpattiḥ| rājaniṣṭhakāryotpādakatāyāṃ bhṛtyasya svasvāmibhāvasambandhenāvacchedakatve'pyapṛthaksiddhisambandhāvacchinnāvacchedakatvāvirahāt| jñānametasya śarīramiti vyavahāravāraṇāya ca jñānāvacchinnānuyogitākatvaniveśaḥ|| "etena" - vinigamanāviraheṇa jīvaviśiṣṭaśarīrasyāpi kāryotpattiprayojakatvena,jīvaśśarīrasya śararimiti vyavahārāpattiḥ, śarīraniṣṭhakāryotpādakatāyāṃ apṛthaksiddhisambandhena jīvasyāvacchedakatvāditi - "nirastam||" śarīraniṣṭhakāryotpādakatāyāṃ svānuyogikāpṛthaksiddhisambandhapratiyogitvarūpādheyatāsambandhena jīvasyāvacchekatve'pi jñānāvacchinnānuyogitākāpṛthaksiddhisambandhena atathātvāt| muktāderapi śarīraviśiṣṭatvenaiva vihārādikāryajanakatvānna taccharīrādāvapyavyāptiḥ|| etallakṣaṇatrayaphalitaṃ "caturthamapi lakṣaṇaṃ nyāyasiddhāñjane" pratipāditam "yasya cetanasya yadavasthamapṛthaksiddhaviśeṇadravyaṃ tattasya śarīram" iti|| jñānāvacchinnānuyogitākāpṛthaksiddhisambandhanirūpitadravyatvasamānādhikaraṇapratiyogitvaṃ śarīrapadapravṛttinimittamityarthaḥ| etajjīvasyedaṃ śarīramityādau jñānāvacchinnānuyogikāpṛthaksiddhisambandhanirūpitadravyatvasamānādhikaraṇapratiyogitāvacchinnaṃ śarīrapadārthaḥ| tadekadeśajñānāvacchinnānuyogitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhayantārthasyaitajjīvaniṣṭhatvasyānvayāt jñānāvacchinnaitajjīvaniṣṭhānuyogitākāpṛthaksiddhisambandhanirūpitṛdravyatvasamānādhikaraṇapratiyogitvācchinnamidamiti bodhaḥ||siddhānte dharmabhūtajñānasya dravyatvena śarīrātmanoriva jñānātmanorapi apṛthaksiddhisambandhasattvena dravyatvasamānādhikaraṇatādṛśapratiyogitāvattvāt jñānametasya śarīramiti vyavahāravāraṇāya jñānāvacchinnānuyogitākatvaniveśaḥ| jñānāvacchinnānuyogitākāpṛthaksiddhisambandhapratiyogitvasyātmagataparimāṇādau sattvātparimāṇametasya śarīramiti vyavahāravāraṇāya pratiyogitve dravyatvasāmānādhikaraṇyapraveśaḥ|| na ca - etallakṣaṇasya saubhariśarīrādāvavyāptiḥ ; tatraikasmin śarīre jīvāpṛthāksaddhatvasattve'pi śarīrāntare tadasambhavāditi - vācyam|yataśśarīrapadaśakyatāvacchedakamapṛthaksiddhinirūpitadravyatvasamānādhikaraṇapratiyogitvameva| etajjīvasyedaṃ śarīramityādau svaniṣṭhajñānāvacchinnānuyogitākatvasvīyajñānānuyogikatvānyatarasambandhasya ṣaṣṭhayarthatayā viśiṣṭārthalābhaḥ| jīvāpṛthaksiddhirahite saubhariprabhṛtiśarīre'pi jñānāpṛthaksiddhisambandhasya pradīpavadāveśa iti nyāyasiddhatvena svīyajñānānuyogikāpṛthaksiddhisambandhapratiyogitvamādāya tatra śarīravyavahāranirvāhāt|| nanu - śarīrātmanorapṛthaksiddhisambandho na sambhavati, yāvatsattamasambandhānarhayorevāpṛthaksiddhisambandhābhyupagamāt; mṛtaśarīrasya jīvasambandharahitatayā'pyavasthānadarśanena tayoryāvatsattamasambandhānarhatvavirahāt"iti cenna||" pūrvaṃ śarīratayā sthitasya dravyasya cetanaviyogānantarakṣaṇa eva nāśābhyupagamenānupapattivirahāt|| tathā ca "na tu dṛṣṭāntabhāvādityatra śrībhāṣyam" "mṛtaśarīraṃ tu cetanaviyogakṣaṇa eva viśarītumārabdhaṃ kṣaṇāntare viśīryate| pūrvaśarīratayā pariklṛptasaṃghātaikadeśatvena tatra śarīratvavyavahāraḥ|" iti|| evameva pūrvalakṣaṇeṣvapyavyāptiparihāra ūhyaḥ|| ityāhuḥ|| "anye tu" - yasya cetanasyetyādibhāṣyamekalakṣaṇaparameva, na tu lakṣaṇatrayaparam| tatsūcakavākārādyabhāvāt|; ādheyatvavidheyatvaśeṣatvāni pravṛttinimittamiti bhāṣyavirodhāñca| tatra pratyekadharmasya śakyatāvacchedakatve'tiprasaktivirahe'pi samudāyasya tathātvasvīkārastu śarīrapadādādheyatbavidheyatvaśeṣatvānāṃ bodhānubhavādeva|| na ca - etajjīvasyedaṃ śarīramiti vākyajanyabodhānantaramidaṃdārthaviśeṣyakajīvādheyatvādisaṃśayaḥ kasyāpi jāyate| atra ādheyatvāditrayasya śarīrapadajanyabodhaviṣayatvāvaśyakatayā samudāyasya tacchakyatāvacchedakatvamādaśyakaṃ| yathā padmatvasyānatiprasaktatve'pi paṅkajanikartṛtvasya bodhānurodhena paṅkajādipadaśakyatāvacchedakatvasvīkāraḥ|| "nanu" - etajjīvasyedaṃ śarīramiti vākyādādheyatvāditritayasya bodhe'pi na tritayasya śakyatāvacchedakatvāvaśyakatā, tatrādheyatvamātrasya śakyatāvacchedakatve'pi vidheyatvaśeṣatvayorarthāpattivaśena bhānasambhavāt| siddhānte padajanyapadārthopasthitiviṣayasyeva arthāpattiviṣayasyāpi śābdabodhe bhānāṅgīkārāt, śarīratvamādheyatvaśeṣatvābhyāṃ vinā anupapannamityarthāpatteḥ prakṛte'ti sambhavāt| ata eva hi ghaṭenajalamāharetyādau chidretaratvaṃ vinā jalāharaṇamanupapannamityarthāpattiviṣayīkṛtasya chidretaratvasya śābdabodhabhānamānubhāvikam"iti cenna|| "ākṣepataḥ prāptādābhidhānikasyaiva grāhyatvāta" iti bhāṣyānurodhena arthāpattiviṣayasya śābdabodhe bhānasya śaktyasambhavasthala eva svīkārāt|| iti vadanti|| "yasya vedāśśarīraṃ, yasya yajñāśśarīram" ityādau vedayajñapadayostadabhimānidevatāparatvasya "śrutaprakāśikāyāmuktatvāt" uktaśarīralakṣaṇasya vedayajñayorasattve'pina kṣatiḥ|| yadyapi devatoddeśyakadravyatyāgarūpayajñapadārthaikadeśadravye śarīrapadārthasyābhedānvayasambhavāt vedayantīti vedāḥ - iti vyutpattisiddhajñānasādhanatvarūpayaugikārthaghaṭakajñāne ca tatsambhavādvedayajñapadayorlakṣaṇābhyupagamo vyarthaḥ| tathā'pi saṃyogānukūlakriyārūpagamanapadārthaikadeśasaṃyoge guṇābhedānvayatātparyeṇa gamanaṃ guṇa ityādivyavahāravāraṇāya abhedasambandhāvacchinnaprakāratānirūpitaviśeṣyatāsambandhena śābdabodhaṃ prati padajanyopasthitermukhyaviśeṣyatāsambandhena hetutvāvaśyakatayā prakṛte'pyekadeśe abhedānvabodhāsambhavamabhipretya vedayajñapadayorlakṣaṇāsvīkārānnānupapattiḥ|| "paramasundaraḥ paramātmā" ityādau paramapadārthasya sundarapadārthaikadeśe saundarye ātmapadārthaikadeśajñāne cābhedānvayabodhapratipādanaṃ "gadādharādīnāṃ" gatyantaraviraheṇaiva| tathā'nvayaṃ vinā tādṛśatātparyānirvāhāditi dhyeyam|| "tārkikāstu""ceṣṭendriyārthāśrayaśśarīram" itisūtrānurodhādantyāvayavitve sati ceṣṭāvattvaṃ, antyāvayavitve sati indriyāśrayatvaṃ, antyāvayavitve sati bhogāvacchedakatvaṃ vā śarīrapadapravṛttinimittaṃ|| tatra "prathame" etajjīvasyedaṃ śarīramityādau kṛtiprayojyatvasya ṣaṣṭhayarthasya śarīrapadārthaikadeśaceṣṭāvadidimiti bodhaḥ|| "dvitīye" ṣaṣṭhayarthasya jñānajanakatvasya śarīrapadārthaikadeśe indriye anvayādantyāvayavitvasamānādhikaraṇaitajjīvaniṣṭhajñānajanakendriyāśraya idamiti bodhaḥ|| "tṛtīye" ṣaṣṭhayarthādheyatvasyavitvasamānādhikaraṇāvacchedakatāvadidamiti bodhaḥ|| hastaḥ etasya śarīramiti vyavahāravāraṇāya sarvatra satyantam"ityāhuḥ|| "tañcintyaṃ||prathamakalpe" ceṣṭāśabdena kriyāmātravivakṣāyāṃ ghaṭodevadattaśararimitivyavahārāpattiḥ ;devadattakṛtijanyakriyāvattvasya antyāvayavitvasamānādhikaraṇasya ghaṭe sattvāt| hitāhitaprāptiparihārānukūlakriyāyā vijātīyāyā vā ceṣṭāśabdena vivakṣaṇe devadatta īśvarasya śarīramiti vyavahārasya bhavadanabhimatasya prasaṅgaḥ; īśvarakṛtiprayuktaceṣṭāvattvasya devadatte sattvāt| kṛtyasādhāraṇakāraṇakatvasya ṣaṣṭhayarthatāsvīkāreṇoktātiprasaṅgavāraṇe'pi ahalyādiśarīrabhūtaśilādāvuktalakṣaṇāvyāptirdurvārā|| "dvitīye" samavāyena indriyavattvavivakṣaṇe asambhavaḥ indriyāvayaveṣvativyāptiśca| saṃyogena tadvivakṣaṇe ghaṭādāvatiprasaṅgaḥ, svajanyajñānāvacchedakatvasambandhena tadvivakṣaṇe ca rāmādiśarīreṣvavyāptiḥ; īśvarajñānasya nityatvāt, vyāpyavṛttitvenāvacchedakanirapekṣatvāñca; śilākāṣṭhādirūpāhalyādiśarīre'vyāptiśca|| "tṛtīye" veśmādāvativyāptiḥ; vane siṃhanāda ityādau siṃhakaṇṭhāvacchedena jāyamānaśabdaṃ prati vanasyeva dehāvacchedena jāyamānabhogaṃ prati veśmāderavacchedakatvasambhavāt, veśmanyasya bhoga iti vyavahārāñca|| na ca - svāvayavātiriktadeśānavacchinnatvasya bhoganirūpitāvacchedakatāyāṃ niveśānna doṣaḥ; veśmanaśca dehāvacchinnasyaivāvacchedakatvāt,tvasya deśaviśeṣaṇatvāñca nāsambhavaḥ; śarīraniṣṭhāvacchedakatāyāḥ pāde sukhamityanurodhena svāvayavāvacchinnatve'pi tadatiriktadeśānavacchinnatvāt - iti vācyam| parakāyasya praviṣṭaṃ prati śarīratvāpatteḥ; īśvarabhogasya vyāpyavṛttitvena tadavacchedakāprasiddhayā rāmaśarīrādā vavyāpteśca|| "tathā ca apītau tadvatprasaṅgādasamañjasamityatra śrībhāṣyam "na ca bhogāyatanatvaṃ śarīratvamiti śarīratvasambhavaḥ, bhogāyataneṣu veśmādiṣu śarīratvāprasiddheḥ| yatra vartamānasyaiva sukhaduḥkhopabhogastadeva bhogāyatanam iti cenna, parakāyapraveśajanyasukhaduḥkhabhogāyatanasya parakāyasya praviṣṭaṃ prati śarīratvāprasiddheḥ| īśvarasya tu svatassiddhanityaniratiśayānandasya bhogaṃ prati cidacidvastunorāyatanatvaniyamo na sambhavati||" iti|| āyatanatvamavacchekatvaṃ śaṅkate - yatra vartamānasyaiveti| vartamānasya yasya yatraiva sukhaduḥkhopabhoga ityanvayena yanniṣṭhaniravacchinnāvacchedakatākaḥ sukhādisākṣātkāra ityarthaḥ| tralarthāvacchedakatāyāmevakārārthasya svāvayavātiriktadeśānavacchinnatvasyānvayena nacetyādyasmaduktaśaṅkāyāmeva bhāṣyatātparyāt|| ānande niratiśayatvaṃ ca vyāpyavṛttitvaṃ bodhyam| tasmācchrībhāṣyoktalakṣaṇameva lokavedaprayogānuguṇam| tathā ca acidvastūnāmiva cidvastūnāmapi paramātmaśarīratvāccharīravāciśabdānāṃ śarīriparyantatvāt,"sarvaṃ khalvidaṃ brahma","ayamātmā brahma","tattvamasi"ityādisamānādhikaraṇavyavahāropapattiḥ| ata eva - "anena jīvenātmanā'nupraviśya nāmarūpe vyākaravāṇi" - ityanupraveśapūrvakanāmarūpavyākaraṇaṃ paramātmana upapadyate| jīvenātmanetyatra jīvaśarīrakeṇa mayetyarthāt| anyathā yathāśrutānurodhājjīvātmana evānupraveśakartṛtvasvīkāre - "tadevānuprāviśat,tadanupraviśya,sañca tyañcābhavat" - iti paramātmano'nupraveśakartṛtvapratipādakaśrutyantaravirodhāpāttiḥ|| "nanvevam" - ātmaneti tṛtīyā'nupapattiḥ, vyākaravāṇīti tiṅā karturabhidānāt, anabhihite kartarīti vidhānāt, svottarapratyayabhinnasvasamabhivyāhṛtapadasāmānyavṛttikartṛtvādibodhatātparyābhāvakaṃ yatsvaṃ tasmāttṛtīyādirbhavatīti hi tṛtīyetyādyanuśāsanārthaḥ| svaṃ - tṛtīyādiprakṛtiḥ| "caitreṇa pacyate taṇḍulaḥ" ityādau svaṃ - caitrapadaṃ, tatsamabhivyāhṛtataduttarapratyayabhinnapadasāmānye kartṛtvabodhatātparyakatvābhāvasattvāttasmāt tṛtīyopapattiḥ| prakṛte ca tādṛśaṃ svaṃ nātmapadaṃ, tatsamabhivyāhṛtataduttarapratyayabhinnapadasāmānyāntargatatiṅādau kartṛtvatātparyakatvasyaiva sattvāt|| na ca - vyākaraṇakartṛtvatātparyakatvasya tiṅādau sattvepyanupraveśakartṛtvatātparyakatvavirahasya svottarapratyayabhinnasvasamabhivyāhṛtapadasāmānye sattvādātmapadāttṛtīyopapattiḥ; svatātparyaviṣayībhūtārthaniṣṭhasvasamabhivyāhṛtayatkiñcitkriyānirūpitakartṛtvatātparyakatvā bhāvavat svasamabhivyāhṛtasvottarapratyayabhinnapadasāmānyakaṃ yatsavaṃ tasmāttṛtīyādirityanuśāsanārthāṅgīkārāt - iti vācyam| tathā sati "pakvāni bhuṅkte caitraḥ" ityādau caitrapadāttṛtīyāpatteḥ| svaṃ - caitrapadaṃ tattātparyaviṣayībhūtacaitrādirūpārthaniṣṭhaṃ yat yatkiñcitsvasamabhivyāhṛtapākakartṛtvaṃ tattātparyakatvābhāvasya svasamabhivyāhṛtapadasāmānye sattvāt| ataḥ svatātparyaviṣayībhūtārthaniṣṭhapradhānakriyānirūpitakartṛtvatātparyakatvābhāvavat svasamabhivyāhṛtapadasāmānyakaṃ yatsvaṃ tasmāttṛtīyādirityevānuśāsanārtho vācyaḥ| pakvāni bhuṅkte caitra ityādau caitraniṣṭhaṃ yatpradhānakriyākartṛtvaṃ bhojanakartṛtvarūpaṃ tattātparyakatvasyaiva svasamabhivyāhṛtapadasāmānyāntargatatiṅādau sattvānnānupapattiḥ| prakṛte cātmapadatātparyaviṣayībhūtārthaniṣṭhaṃ yatpradhānabhūtavyākaraṇakriyākartṛtvaṃ tattātparyakatvasyaiva svasamabhivyāhṛtapadasāmānyāntargatatiṅādau sattvena na tādṛśaṃ svamātmapadamitiṃ tasmātṛtīyānupapattiḥ - "iti cet||" "atra brūmaḥ" - samānākārakajñāneṣu viṣayatābhedānaṅgīkartṛnaiyāyikādimate - "caitreṇa dṛśyamānaṃ ghaṭaṃ maitraḥ paśyati" - ityādau dvitīyānupapattiḥ| caitradarśanamaitradarśanobhayanirūpitaṃ viṣayatvarūpaṃ karmatvamekamiti ghaṭaniṣṭhaṃ yatpradhānakriyānirūpitaviṣayatvādirūpaṃ kartṛtvaṃ tattātparyakatvasyaiva svasamabhivyāhṛtapadasāmānyāntargatakṛtpratyaye satvānna tādṛśaṃ svaṃ ghaṭapadamiti "anabhihite kartari" ityādeḥ kartṛtvādiviśeṣyatayā prātipadikārthe avivakṣite sati tṛtīyetyevārthaḥ| prātipadikārthaviśeṣaṇatayaiva kartṛtve avivakṣite iti yāvat| avadhāraṇaparatayā prātipadikārthaviśeṣyatayā kartṛtve vivakṣite taduttaraṃ tṛtīyetiparyavasitārthaḥ svīkāryaḥ| caitreṇa dṛśyamānaṃ ghaṭaṃ maitraḥ paśyatītyādau prātipadikārthaviśeṣyatayā karmatvasya vivakṣaṇāddvitīyopapattiḥ evaṃ ca anena jīvenātmanā'nupraviśya ityādau prātipadikārthaviśeṣyatayā kartṛtvasya vivakṣaṇāñca tṛtīyopapattiḥ|| "athaive" - caitrādikartṛtvaviśeṣitapākāditātparyeṇa caitreṇa pacatīti prayogāpattiḥ| evaṃ caitramaitrobhayakartṛkapākasthale caitrakartṛkapākakartā maitra ityanvayatātparyeṇa "caitreṇa pacati maitraḥ" iti prayogāpattiśca| kartṛtvaviśeṣaṇatā'nāpannakriyāyāṃ tṛtīyārthakartṛtvānvayavyutpattimaṅgīkṛtya uktāpattivāraṇe ca "caitreṇa pācayati maitraḥ" ityādau ṇyarthakartṛtvaviśeṣaṇatāpannapākādau tṛtīyārthakartṛtvānvayānupapattiḥ - "iti cenna||"āśrayātiriktaviśeṣaṇatā'nāpannakartṛtvaviśeṣaṇā'nāpannakriyāyāmeva tṛtīyārthakartṛtvānvaya iti vyutpattisvīkāreṇoktadoṣābhāvāt,caitreṇa pācayātītyādau kartṛtvanirvāhakavyāpāro ṇijarthaḥ| tatrāśrayātirikte vyāpāre kartṛtvaṃ viśeṣaṇamiti tadviśeṣaṇatāpannakriyāyāṃ tṛtīyārthakartṛtvasya viśeṣaṇatve na kiṃ cidbādhakaṃ| caitreṇa pacati maitra ityādayaśca na prayogāḥ| tatrāśraya eva kṛterviśeṣaṇatayā tadviśeṣaṇatāpannakriyāyāṃ tṛtīyārthakartṛtvasya bodhanāsambhavāt kṛtiviśeṣyakabodhābhiprāyeṇa caitreṇa pacatīti vāraṇāyāśrayaviśeṣaṇatvamupekṣya tadatiriktaviśeṣaṇatvaniveśaḥ| iti|| "jñānaratnaprakāśikākṛtastu" - "anabhihite kartari tṛtīyā"ityādeḥ svatātparyaviṣayībhūtārthaniṣṭhasvasamabhivyāhṛtayatkiñcitkriyānirūpitakartṛtvatātparyakatvābhāvavat svasamabhivyāhṛtasāmānyakaṃ yatsvaṃ tasmāttṛtīyādirityevārthaḥ|| na caivaṃ - pakvāni bhuṅkte caitra ityādau caitrapadāttṛtīyāpattiḥ, caitraniṣṭhaṃ yatpākādikartṛtvaṃ tattātparyakatvābhāvasya svasamabhivyāhṛtapadasāmānye sattvāt - iti vācyam| svasamabhivyāhṛtapadābhihitapradhānakriyānirūpitakartṛtvādiniṣṭhaviṣayatānirūpitaviṣayatāprayojakabhinnatvasya svapadārthe viśeṣaṇatvenānupapattyabhāvāt, pakvāni bhuṅkakte caitra ityādau caitrapadasyākhyātābhihitapradhānakriyākartṛtvaniṣṭhaviṣayatānirūpitaviṣayatāprayojakaṃ yadahamādipadaṃ tadbhinnatvasyātmapade sattvāt ātmapadatātparyaviṣayībhūtārthaniṣṭhānupraveśakartṛtvatātparyakatvavirahasya svasamabhivyāhṛtapadasāmānye sattvāñcātmapadāttṛtīyopapattiḥ|| iti vadanti|| atra yadyapi caitreṇa dṛśyamānaṃ ghaṭaṃ maitraḥ paśyatītyādau ghaṭapadasya śānacpratyayābhihitapradhānakriyākarmatvaniṣṭhaviṣayatānirūpitaviṣayatāprayojakatvena tadbhinnatvābhāvāt dvitīyānupapattiḥ|| na ca - siddhānte jñānabhedena jñānasaṃyogātmakaviṣayatāyā bhedānnānupapattiḥ, siddhānte jñānasya dravyatvena prasaraṇavattvena ca tatsaṃyogasyaiva viṣayatārūpatvāt - iti vācyam| evamapi dhārāvāhikajñānasya ghaṭasambaddhasthiradravyātmakasya aikye tatsthale tādṛśajñānasya gṛhītagrāhitvatātparyeṇa jñātameva jānātīti vyavahārānupapattiḥ| tatratra pradhānāpradhānakriyayoraikye tatsaṃyogasyāpyaikyena ktapratyayena pradhānakriyākarmatvasyaivābhidhānāt| tathā'pi dhārāvāhikajñānasthale nirantarajñānasantatireva, na tvekajñānamiti - teṣāmāśayaḥ|| yadica - dhārāvāhikajñānasthale jñānaikyamānubhāvikaṃ siddhāntasiddhaṃ ca tadā'smaduktarītyā tatrāpi nānupapattiḥ| tathā ca - anupraveśapūrvakaṃ nāmarūpavyākaraṇaṃ paramātmana eveti siddham|| "nanvidamanupapannam" - paramātmano vibhutvārṅgakārāt| anupraveśo hi - antassaṃyogāvacchikriyārūpo gativiśeṣaḥ| gatiśca - vibhutvābhāvasādhakatayā sūtrakāreṇaiva nirdiṣṭā "utkrāntigatyā gatinām" iti| tasmādaṇorjīvasyaivānupraveśo yuktaḥ - "iti cet||ucyate" - anupraveśasya gativiśaṣarūpatve'pi tasya jīvaniṣṭhatvāt| paramātmakṛtijanyatvena tatkartṛkatvāñca nānupapattiḥ| yathā hi - naiyāyikādinaye devadatto grāmaṃ gacchatītyatra jīvasya vibhutve'pi śarīraniṣṭhā yā saṃyogānukūlakriyā tadanukūlakṛtimattvameva devadattaśarīrāvacchinnātmani pratīyate, na tu gamanādirūpakriyāvattvaṃ| sarvatra śarīraniṣṭhakriyānukūlakṛterevātmani bhānāṅgīkārāt| tathā "anupraviśya nāmarūpe vyākaravāṇi" ityatra anupraveśarūpadhātvarthottarakālīnatvasya lyabantārthasya svaprakṛtyarthasamānakartṛkatvaviśiṣṭāśrayatāsambandheta nāmarūpavyākaraṇe'nvayāṅgīkārāt paramātmani jīvarūpaśarīraniṣṭhānupraveśānukūlakṛtimattvaṃ bhāsate,na tvanupraveśavattvamiti nānupapattiḥ|| na ca - evaṃ jīvasya vibhutve'pi gatyādikartṛtvamupapadyate, śarīraniṣṭhagamanādirūpakriyāṃ prati kartṛtvasambhavāt, grāmaṃ gacchatītyādivat - iti vācyam| yata utkrāntyādisūtraṃ naiyāyikamatanirākaraṇaparaṃ; tathāhi - jīvo vibhutvābhāvavān, kriyāvattvāt - ityanumānamabhipretya tatra svarūpāsiddhiśaṅkānirāsakatayā utkrāntītyādisūtraṃ pravṛttam|| tathā ca - utkrāntyādinā śrutisiddhatvānna svarūpāsiddhatvamitibhāvaḥ| ūrdhvadeśasaṃyogāvacchinnakriyātvādirūpotkrāntitvādinā ca hetutvaṃ na sambhavati, nalidhūmādivadvaiyarthyāt|| "atha" - "tena pradyotenaiṣa ātmā niṣkrāmati, cakṣuṣo vā mūrdhno vā'nyebhyo vā śarīradeśebhyaḥ" ityutkrāntipratipādakaśrutyā,"ye vaike cāsmāllokātprayanti, candramasameva te sarve gacchanti" "tasmāllokātpunaretyasmai lokāya karmaṇe" iti gatyāgatipratipādakaśrutibhyāṃ ca śarīraniṣṭhotkrāntyādirūpakriyānukūlakṛtereva ātmani bodhe'pi kriyāvattvasyābodhāt svarūpāsiddhiḥ - "iti cenna|| naiyāyikādinaye utkrāntyādikāle śarīrābhāvena niṣkrāmatītyādinā rathogacchatītyādivat kriyāśrayatvasyaiva bodhāvaśyakatayā kriyāvattvarūpahetorātmani piddheriti sūtrābhiprāyāt| adhikamanyatra vivecitam|| śeṣāryavaṃśaratnena yādavādrinivāsinā| anantāryeṇa racito vādārtho'yaṃ vijṛmbhatām|| iti śrīśeṣāryavaṃśamuktāphalasya śrīyādavādrinivāsasikasya śrīmadanantāryavaryasya kṛtiṣu śarīravādaḥ samāptaḥ| ||śrīḥ||
